```{r}
#packages needed to run
library(plyr)
library(tidyverse)
library(here)
library(data.table)
library(plyr)
library(skimr)
library(lrd)
```
# Control Group

## Read in all control data files from Pavlovia/GitLab

```{r message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, echo=FALSE} 
# read in low test expect data exported from gorilla
#setwd(here::here('Expt2_low_high', "mturk_cue_recall_low")) # folder to find Ps in

#data=here::here("Expt2_low_high", "mturk_cue_recall_low")  # path to data files

data=here::here("data-raw", "Control_Data")

file_list_cont=list.files(data, pattern=".csv") # list of data files

setwd(data)
# read in all files
dataset_ctl <-
  do.call("rbind.fill", lapply(file_list_cont, FUN=function(files){
    
    for (i in 1:length(files)){ 
      if(file.exists(files[i])){
        message( "now processing:", files[i])
      }
    }
    fread(files, header=TRUE, sep=",", na.strings = "", fill=TRUE)}))#fread makes reading in f
```

## Get the columns we need 

```{r}

 dataset_ctl_1 <- dataset_ctl %>% 
  select(participant, Condition, Question, expName,trials_2.thisRepN, textbox_2.text) %>%
  filter(trials_2.thisRepN==0)

dataset_ctl_1

skim(dataset_ctl_1)

```
## LRD

First we need to load in the correct answers and questions and bind it with the full dataset. 

```{r}

preQ<-read_csv(here::here("prequest_answers.csv"))

preQ$Answer<-tolower(preQ$Answer)

preQ$Question<-trimws(preQ$Question)

dataset_ctl_1$Question<-trimws(dataset_ctl_1$Question)

df_merge<-merge(dataset_ctl_1, preQ)

knitr::kable(head(count(df_merge, participant, Question)))
```


```{r}
#remotes::install_github("npm27/lrd")
library(lrd)

df_merge$textbox_2.text[is.na(df_merge$textbox_2.text)] <- "" # does not work if NAs exists

df <- as.data.frame(df_merge) # needs to be data frame

df$trial_id<-rep(1:970) # needs to have unique rows for some reason 
# run lrd 


df$sentences <- df$Answer 

df <- select(df, -Answer)

scored_output_ctl <- prop_correct_sentence(data = df,
 responses = "textbox_2.text",
 key = "sentences", # answer cant be column bc lrd uses it
 key.trial = "trial_id",
 id = "participant",
 id.trial = "trial_id",
 cutoff = 3,
 flag = TRUE,
 group.by = "Condition",
 token.split = " ")

```

# Polio Group

## Read in all control data files from Pavlovia/GitLab

```{r message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, echo=FALSE} 
# read in low test expect data exported from gorilla
#setwd(here::here('Expt2_low_high', "mturk_cue_recall_low")) # folder to find Ps in

#data=here::here("Expt2_low_high", "mturk_cue_recall_low")  # path to data files

data=here::here("data-raw","Polio_Data")

file_list_po=list.files(data, pattern=".csv") # list of data files

setwd(data)
# read in all files
dataset_po <-
  do.call("rbind.fill", lapply(file_list_po, FUN=function(files){
    
    for (i in 1:length(files)){ 
      if(file.exists(files[i])){
        message( "now processing:", files[i])
      }
    }
    fread(files, header=TRUE, sep=",", na.strings = "", fill=TRUE)}))#fread makes reading in f
```

## Get the columns we need 

```{r}

 dataset_po_1 <- dataset_po %>% 
  dplyr::select(participant, Condition, Question, expName, textbox_2.text, trials_2.thisRepN) %>%
  dplyr::filter(trials_2.thisRepN==0) 

dataset_po_1$Question<-trimws(dataset_po_1$Question)

dataset_po_1 <- dataset_po_1 %>%
  mutate(Question=ifelse(Question=="Since the development of the polio vaccine, the global number of polio cases per year has dropped from ______ to ______. is tuberculosis spread through the air?","Since the development of the polio vaccine, the global number of polio cases per year has dropped from ______ to ______.", Question)) # error in question where forgot to remove a question. 
  

dataset_po_1

skim(dataset_po_1)

```
Let's make sure there is one response for each question per participant. 
```{r}


df_merge_po<-merge(dataset_po_1, preQ)

knitr::kable(count(df_merge_po, participant, Question))

```

```{r}

library(lrd)

df_merge_po$textbox_2.text[is.na(df_merge_po$textbox_2.text)] <- "" # does not work if NAs exists

df_po <- as.data.frame(df_merge_po) # needs to be data frame

df_po$trial_id<-rep(1:870) # needs to have unique rows for some reason 
# run lrd 
df_po$sentences <- df_po$Answer 

df_po <- select(df_po, -Answer)


scored_output_po <- prop_correct_sentence(data = df_po,
 responses = "textbox_2.text",
 key = "sentences", # answer cant be column bc lrd uses it
 key.trial = "trial_id",
 id = "participant",
 id.trial = "trial_id",
 cutoff = 3,
 flag = TRUE,
 group.by = "Condition",
 token.split = " ")

```

# Scored Data

Here we do a few thins: 

1. Merge the data from each of the conditions/groups

2. Read in in the scored data file contained in the  "Scored_Data" folder

3. Sum up the earned points

4. Divide by 12 (the total number of points)

5. Pivot wider so for each group (Control, Polio Prequestions, TB Prequestions), we get a
proportion for each question type (Polio and TB)


```{r}
#<-rbind(scored_output_ctl$DF_Scored, scored_output_po$DF_Scored, scored_output_tb$DF_Scored)
scored <- read_csv(here::here("Scored_Data", "pilot_scored_data", "all_scored_jg.csv"))
                   
scored_agg<- scored %>%
   dplyr::mutate(group=ifelse(expName=="preQ", "Polio", ifelse(expName=="preQ_control", "control", "TB"))) %>% 
  dplyr::group_by(Sub.ID, group, Condition, Points)

knitr::kable(scored_agg)

```

# Visualize

```{r}

library(modelbased)

scored <- read_csv(here::here("Scored_Data", "pilot_scored_data", "all_scored_jg.csv"))
                   

scored <- scored %>% 
  dplyr::select(Sub.ID, expName, questnum, Condition, Points, earned_points) %>%    
  dplyr::filter(expName!="preQ_TB") %>%
  dplyr::mutate(earned_points=ifelse(earned_points==4.5, 4, earned_points), group=ifelse(expName=='preQ', "Prequestion Group", "Control Group"), condition=ifelse(Condition=="Polio", "Prequestioned", "Non-prequestioned")) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(prop=earned_points/Points)

model1 <- glmer(earned_points/Points~ group*condition+ (1|Sub.ID),  weights=Points, family=binomial, data=scored) 

```


```{r}
# 3. Plot

d=ggplot(scored, aes(x = group, y = prop)) + facet_grid(~ condition) + 

  # Add pointrange and line from means

  geom_pointrange(
    data = contrasts,
    aes(y = Probability, ymin = CI_low, ymax = CI_high),
    size = 1,
    color = "black"
  ) +
  # Improve colors

  theme_modern()

d
```
